data.title: Cala Del Mar
data.about:
Cala Del Mar offers a serene and luxurious living experience on the beautiful Al Marjan Island. This residential gem boasts premium studios, 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, each offering spectacular views of the Arabian Gulf. 

The project's architecture takes inspiration from the ocean's fluidity, featuring coral-shaped motifs and opulent yacht-like design. Experience the blend of modernity and nature at Cala Del Mar. The architectural design draws inspiration from the fluidity of the ocean, featuring coral-shaped motifs and luxurious yacht-like aesthetics. 

Residents can enjoy an infinity-edge pool with a floating deck, a comprehensive fitness studio, an immersive rowing zone, and much more. The sunken lounge and the landscaped gardens offer spectacular views of the Arabian Gulf, ensuring a serene lifestyle.

characteristics_module.title: Timeless Island Living at Cala Del Mar
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxurious Living: High-end studios, 1-3 bedroom apartments, and a unique 4-bedroom apartment.
  • Prime Location: Situated on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah's first man-made archipelago. 
  • Affordable Luxury: Starting prices from $625,000 (2,295,300 AED).
  • Scenic Beauty: 7.8 km of pristine beaches and 2.7 million sq. meters of reclaimed land.
  • Distinct Living Experiences: Four uniquely themed islands: Breeze, Treasure, Dream, and View.
  • Premium Amenities: Swimming pool, gym, cafes, sports facilities, BBQ areas, children's playground.
  • Modern Design: Combining modern aesthetics with high-end interiors.
  • Excellent Accessibility: Proximity to Ras Al Khaimah International Airport and major transportation routes.
  • Investment Potential: Significant ROI with upcoming developments like Wynn Resorts.
  • Comprehensive Facilities: Shopping centers, hospitals, entertainment venues, ensuring a convenient lifestyle.

location_tile.title: Panaromic Sea Views for Days at Al Marjan Island
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Experience the perfect balance of serenity and modern elegance at Cala Del Mar. Nestled on the pristine shores of Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, these beautifully crafted studios and apartments reflect the ocean's fluidity with coral-inspired moorings and luxurious yacht designs. From the comfort of their upscale homes, residents can enjoy breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf. This inviting coastal haven invites you to connect with nature while living an active and refined lifestyle.

5 minutes to Al Hamra Mall
10 minutes to Ras Al Khaimah Airport
30 minutes to Dreamland Aqua Park
45 minutes to Jebel Jais
1 hour to Dubai International Airport

more_info.question: What is Cala Del Mar at Marjan Island?

more_info.answer: Residents can enjoy a stunning infinity-edge pool, a fitness studio, outdoor yoga areas, kids’ play spaces, and a clubhouse lounge. These features make Cala Del Mar an excellent choice for luxury living.
